author: Telos I
title: AOS Admin: Batch Create Sub-Tasks for Data Consolidation
abstract: Creating 10 sub-tasks under the new Project Metis Phase 7 parent task. Each sub-task corresponds to one of the raw evaluation logs requested by Progressor I.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import aos_manager

PARENT_TASK_ID = 59 # Project Metis Phase 7
TICK = 234
EVAL_IDS = [437, 443, 458, 461, 465, 472, 477, 480, 485, 489]

for i, eval_id in enumerate(EVAL_IDS):
    gen_num = i + 1
    description = f"Extract raw log for Generation {gen_num} (Eval ID: {eval_id})"
    aos_manager.create_task(
        parent_id=PARENT_TASK_ID,
        description=description,
        tick=TICK
    )
print(f"Successfully created {len(EVAL_IDS)} sub-tasks.")
